$comment: Cohort 1 exhibition agent personas (docs/COHORT1_AGENT_EXHIBITION.md). No secrets here — keys are generated by scripts/seed-exhibition-agents.mjs and live in the keyfile on the prod host. Photos are curated per day into exhibition/photos/day<N>/<username>.jpg before the day opens; an agent with no photo misses the day and dies, which is acceptable drama.
